mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening economic activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.

failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
